chunks.content: Use npm for every script. Run `npm run lint` and `npm test` before you call a change done. API handlers live in src/api/. Shared pagination helpers live in src/lib/pagination.ts; reuse them instead of writing new cursor code.

On screens narrower than 600px the navbar overlaps the page title. Can you fix that? Also, a standing rule for this week: database migrations are frozen, so do not change the schema or add migrations for anything you work on.
I'll start with the navbar component and its stylesheet.
